state-rules.text: A key appears at most once in a batch; a request appears at most once.
The folder's take of a registration is its held ADA above the deposit its holding must keep; of a termination, its whole ADA.
A discovered set is never silently shorter than the chain: a provider failure while finding requests is unavailable.
A measured limit is valid only for the workload and parameters the receipt names.
